verdict.rationale: Cline's pricing page directly says users can 'self-host anytime'. The core agent installs and runs locally via npm, IDE extensions, or a native app, and it supports fully local models through Ollama or LM Studio, so the whole stack can stay on the user's own machines. Missing for 10: dedicated self-hosting or deployment documentation, an explicitly evidenced open-source license, and independent hands-on corroboration of a fully self-hosted setup (community reports describe local-model quality as mixed).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: You're never locked into our platform or pricing. Switch providers or self-host anytime.
Run Cline with local models using Ollama, LM Studio or Atomic Chat.
Bring Your Own Key (BYOK): use your own provider credentials (cloud or local runtimes).
